notes.title: Full Release!
notes.notes:
this is the full release of birdsborough which new features decorations bug fixes and more!
decor can now be recoloured, npcs have been reworked and the game is in a completed state.

notes.title: minor update
notes.notes: a few fixes and visual updates, added "auto-plant" to plant all connected plants at once and new npc dialogue

notes.title: small tutorial update
notes.notes:
small tutorial update! all menus will be explained when first opened and the tutorial can be reset in the options
a new type of wall and street lamp has also been added

notes.title: NPC update!
notes.notes: this update adds 4 unique NPCs each with procedurally generated dialogue, the start of an affinity system, a simple tutorial and more uniquely random NPCs
